verdict.rationale: Circle documents APIs to create wallets per user, including user-controlled wallets created at user initialization, and developer-controlled wallets organized in wallet sets. That gives each customer a dedicated onchain address, so incoming funds can be attributed, and webhooks fire on resource state changes. The evidence never frames this as deposit attribution or reconciliation, and it shows no named virtual accounts for fiat. Missing for 10: explicit per-customer deposit address or virtual account feature, fiat virtual account numbers, documented reconciliation of incoming payments to customers, independent or hands-on corroboration.
